result.title: FundingClaw: Automated Grant Proposal Writing Agents System
result.summary: Grant proposal writing remains a manual, labor-intensive bottleneck: proposals must satisfy rigid, agency-specific templates, and the same intellectual content must be repeatedly re-encoded into incompatible formats across funding organizations. We introduce FundingClaw, a multi-agent framework built on template-driven skill selection, where a Template Parser ingests any agency's specification and selects the appropriate writing skills for each stage, so that one research brief can produce compliant proposals for NSFC, NSF, KAKENHI, or ERC without modifying generation logic. A blueprint-skeleton strategy drafts a structured outline before any prose is written, mitigating the semantic drift that plagues long-form generation. Three sequential stages produce the rationale, research content, and research foundation sections, with multi-source verification of the PI's record and optional PDF-grounded extraction of representative works. Optional human feedback checkpoints and a closed-loop self-review complete the pipeline. Evaluated on ten research topics with an eight-dimension rubric, FundingClaw outperforms the baseline, narrowing the gap with human level for laborious funding proposal. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FundingClaw 多智能体框架，用模板解析与技能选择让同一研究简介适配 NSFC、NSF、KAKENHI、ERC 等不同基金模板，并以「蓝图—骨架」先列提纲、三阶段分节写作、自审闭环生成申请书。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于长文写作流程的工程化多智能体应用，既无视觉或多模态推理状态分析，也无 latent 表示、证据使用或停止决策层面的可核查线索，模板解析与骨架策略只是一般 prompt 流程编排。
